rule: Tuning set only (20 original scenarios, nominal plant). Admissible = Pareto front points with mean E_mech >= mean floor and peak overshoot < overshoot_max_cm. economical = lowest E_mech admissible. fast = lowest E_mech within fast_band_s of the fastest admissible. balanced = admissible point between them closest to (t_fast, E_economical) on axes normalised by the fast-economical span.
